create_Bunch: create a Bunch object from sklearn.utils to store dictionary-like attributes
test_Bunch_deprecation: test that Bunch raises a FutureWarning when accessing a deprecated key via __getattr__
test_Bunch_set_deprecated: test that Bunch._set_deprecated maps a deprecated key to a new key and emits a warning
test_Bunch_new_key_access: test that accessing the new key on a Bunch does not emit any deprecation warning
test_Bunch_dict_access: test that Bunch supports dictionary-style key access for both new and deprecated keys
